annotation.bound_parties_text: Personal delivery device operators, eligible entities that own and operate personal delivery devices, and any person operating a personal delivery device in Arizona; local authorities are limited from allowing operation on nonmotorized trails or bicycle paths.
annotation.bound_parties_quote: A PERSON MAY NOT OPERATE A PERSONAL DELIVERY DEVICE IN THIS STATE UNLESS THE PERSON IS AUTHORIZED TO DO SO UNDER THIS SECTION AND COMPLIES WITH THIS SECTION.
annotation.robot_provision_quote: IS EQUIPPED WITH TECHNOLOGY TO ALLOW FOR THE OPERATION OF THE DEVICE WITH OR WITHOUT THE ACTIVE CONTROL OR MONITORING OF A NATURAL PERSON.
